name: Human crew seat
description: One person, couch, suit, and 210 days of transit consumables adder.

name: Optimus work unit
description: Humanoid labor. No O₂, no food, no morale. Cannot do surgery. Can stack cargo and bolt habitats.

name: ECLSS life-support pack
description: O₂, CO₂ scrub, 88% water recovery. Four humans, one window. Without this, crew is a stunt.

name: MOXIE O₂ generator
description: Solid-oxide electrolysis: 2 CO₂ → 2 CO + O₂. Backup air from the atmosphere. Cheap insurance.

name: Landed habitat module
description: Pressurized can. Lands ready. Heavy, expensive, instant.

name: Solar array, 100 m²
description: ~4 kW sol-average on a clear day. Dust will eat it.

name: Kilopower reactor, 10 kW
description: The reason you survive a global dust storm.

name: Water-ice extraction rig
description: Drill, heat, bag. Throughput scales with ice abundance.

name: Sabatier / electrolysis plant
description: CO₂ + 4 H₂ → CH₄ + 2 H₂O. Return propellant. Catalyst is an Earth import.

name: Greenhouse kit, 50 m²
description: LED-lit hydroponics. ~11 kW. One kit is not closure. Do the math: 52 m²/person.

name: Spares pallet, 1 t
description: Gaskets, pumps, filters, boards. Under-manifesting this is how Year 14 kills you.

name: Food (dry), 1 t
description: 1.8 kg/person/sol. A tonne is 555 person-sols. Pack more than you think.

name: Water, 1 t
description: Drink, hygiene, electrolysis. Recycle it or you are a tanker, not a colony.

name: Water recycling loop
description: Urine, condensate, hygiene. ~92% recovery. Gardens and ice do the rest.

name: Unpressurized cargo rover
description: 40 km range. The thing that retrieves the lander that missed.

name: Methalox tanker load
description: Header-tank propellant for a LEO tanker. Dock, pump, keep a deorbit reserve, send the tanker home.

name: Science package
description: Instruments. Discoveries print money and support. Not optional if you like funding.
